package.name: panda_voice_stack
package.description: Voice control for the Franka Emika Panda arm: spoken commands are recognized offline with Vosk and turned into MoveIt pick-and-place motions, so blocks A, B and C can be picked up and stacked by talking to the robot. The Gazebo scene comes from panda_block_stack; the recognizer follows the same pattern as tb3_voice_control.
